info.name: CS301 - Lab 7 Tasks 1 and 2
info.description: Start task1.js on port 3004 and task2/server.js on port 3005. Run each folder from top to bottom. IDs are saved automatically. Use Body > raw > JSON for writes. Task 1 loses records after a server restart. Task 2 saves to task2/data/store.json. Task 2 is a local lab demo with one shared cart; login checks credentials without creating sessions or restricting routes. Checkout records an order without processing payment. To check persistence, stop and restart Task 2, then repeat View saved order and List original catalogue. Demo orders/customers remain on disk.
